title: Man With 13 Fake IDs Gets Caught Trying To Commit Bank Fraud
description:
#news #police #arrest

On February 28th, 2023. Officers received reports of a man who was trying to get bank checks from an account that did not belong to him. When the officer arrived, the bank manager notified him that there was another male that was with him and had left the bank prior to the officer's arrival. It was said that the male was trying a black Mercedes. The officer immediately put out an ABP on that vehicle. When the officer was getting information from the suspect. He kept saying "They forced him to do it" referring to the males he was with. The man in the bank was identified as 58-year-old "Burnie".

Officers from another department were on a chase with the men in the black Mercedes when they threw out multiple fake IDs all with pictures of the man's face on it.
